summary: junipernetworks.junos added deprecation warnings for junos_ospfv2 area_range and the junos_acl_interfaces key in junos facts.
questions: junos_ospfv2 warns about area_range, is it deprecated?
Why do junos facts warn about junos_acl_interfaces?

answer_card.title: junos deprecation warnings
answer_card.answer_md: `junos_ospfv2` now warns that **`area_range`** is deprecated, and junos facts warn about the **`junos_acl_interfaces`** key. Update tasks that depend on them.
